entities.name: Publius Vitellius the Younger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Publius Vitellius was a first-century Roman commander under Germanicus. He was the son of the eques Publius Vitellius, and belonged to the gens Vitellia. The emperor Vitellius was his nephew.
